A01.note: Teach: single jump, running gap over water, double jump to the door.

A02.note: Drain Well: shortcut ledges at the top, a one-way zigzag descent to the floor hole into A03.

A03.note: Silt Walk: dropped in beside a shut sluice gate; run the silt channels to the wheel at the far end.

shapes.label: Turn the sluice wheel
shapes.done: Far off, a gate grinds open.

A04.note: Cistern Court: cross the high line (decks, a moving barge, crumbles) over the basin; a zigzag climbs back.

A05.note: Spillway Rise: a 70 u climb (room + shaft); timed spill sheets between the columns.

A06.note: Pump Gallery: pistons over the flood going left, a climb, then the high line back right; a wheel opens the A02 shortcut.

shapes.label: Open the shortcut
shapes.done: The way back to the Drain Well is open.

A07.note: Keeper Refuge: rest. Steps down from both doors, flat floor.

A08.note: Sluice Guardian Arena: flat floor, two fight ledges, a zigzag to the Heart door; floor hole to A10.

A09.note: Settling Cache (optional): a zigzag climb back up through the 16 u shaft to A04.

A10.note: Keeper Archive (optional): the long climb back through the 30 u shaft, crumbles in the upper half.

C01.note: Garden Arrival: teach the swing over a thorn bed (a running double jump also clears it), then up to the ceiling shaft.

C02.note: Canopy Walk: two swings over thorns, then a Bloomfall pod bounce up to the door shelf.

C03.note: Root Ladder: drop down the ladder; a thorny right wall up high keeps climbs to the left wall; C10 and the C06 shortcut open off the right.

C04.note: Seed Cradle: the exit gate is shut; climb the left side to the latch by the C09 door, then swing across to the exit.

shapes.label: Release the cradle latch
shapes.done: Far below, the root gate drops open.

C05.note: Rootfall Well: crumbling roots down to the C06 door; moss walls for the way back.

C06.note: Bloom Court: a three-anchor swing chain over thorns to the C07 door; a latch opens the C03 shortcut.

shapes.label: Open the shortcut
shapes.done: The way back to the Root Ladder is open.

C07.note: Gardener Rest: steps down from the door; the floor shaft drops into the arena.

C08.note: Root Guardian Arena: flat floor, fight ledges, a ledge ladder back up to the C07 shaft; floor hole to the Heart.

C09.note: Hidden Nursery (optional): a four-anchor swing over thorns with one island to rest on.

C10.note: Hanging Garden (optional): crumbling roots and a pod over thorns to the high ledge.

D01.note: Windward Shelter: rock below the door; climb on the right, then cross the gust lane in its calm.

D02.note: Leeward Well: descend through two gust bands to the floor shaft; the D04 shortcut joins low.

D03.note: Vane Court: glide from the door down to the floor shaft; the optional D09 lies beyond three timed gusts.

D04.note: Wind Bridge: 36 u over thorns: crumbles, a gust and an island; the D02 shortcut climbs from the island.

D05.note: Updraft Hall: glide left across the hall to the D06 door; a lift and ledges rise to the D10 shaft.

D06.note: Baffled Drop: glide down past alternating rock baffles to the low D07 door.

D08.note: Wind Guardian Arena: flat floor, fight ledges, a ledge ladder to the D05 shortcut shaft; floor hole to the Heart.

D09.note: Glider Roost (optional): glide and dash over thorns with one crumbling perch.

D10.note: Cloud Archive (optional): a lift, then a gust lane to the far ledge.

E01.note: Quiet Arrival: steps up to both doors.

E02.note: Memory Well: down the well, a thread catch on the way; moss walls back up.

E03.note: First Memory: caught under the shaft, then glide (or pod-bounce) across the thorns to the E04 door.

E04.note: Processional Walk: a slow, flat walk.

E05.note: The Wilted Sanctuary: right to left, one of each: glide, swing, gust in its calm, pod bounce, a long jump.

E06.note: Return Stair: wall-jump climb between alternating ledges to the ceiling shaft.

E07.note: Last Refuge: rest, the reward on its pedestal, steps to all three doors.

E08.note: Final Threshold: three steps up to the Heart.

E09.note: Lost Seed Archive (optional): crumbles over thorns up to the shaft.

E10.note: Sanctuary Alcove (optional): cross a gust over thorns to the reward pedestal.

MR01_C06.note: Hanging Garden (way in): hanging ledges over thorns, the reward floor, a moss climb to the High Crevice door.

MR01_C01.note: Warm Crack: the reward on its step, a step up to the Moss Pocket door, a ladder to the ceiling shaft.

MR01_C02.note: Moss Pocket: crumbling roots down over thorns; the heart seed sits high on the right, up the moss wall.

MR01_C03.note: Pale Alcove: the lore stone below, ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

MR01_C04.note: Root Gallery: a rock slab over the floor shaft sends the climb round the left side.

MR01_C05.note: High Crevice: the amber at the foot, thorns on the left floor; climb the right wall back up.

MR02_C06.note: High Arch (way in): an eight-anchor arch over thorns, the reward floor, the floor shaft to the Workshop.

MR02_C01.note: Underarch Workshop: ledges from the Silt Cistern door up to the ceiling shaft.

MR02_C02.note: Silt Cistern: swing the anchor line over the water; the heart seed on its island, a ledge ladder back up.

MR02_C03.note: Echo Vault: anchors from the door shelf up to the ceiling shaft; the reward below on its pedestal.

MR02_C04.note: Ring Gallery: a lift on the left, then ledges round a rock slab to the ceiling shaft.

MR02_C05.note: Moss Tower: the amber at the foot, a thorny low left wall; climb the right wall.

MR03_C06.note: Root Hanger (way in): a swing line to the floor shaft, pods to the reward, a ledge to the Wind Shelf door.

MR03_C01.note: Sluice Cellar: water floor, the heart seed on the dry floor; a pod up to the door shelf, crumbling grain to the ceiling shaft.

MR03_C02.note: Grain Store: crumbling grain steps down from the left door to the right one over thorns; the amber on the dry floor.

MR03_C03.note: Farmer Shelter: a few ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

MR03_C04.note: Mill Undercroft: a rock slab over the floor shaft; a piston lift and ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

MR03_C05.note: Wind Shelf: a ledge walk through timed wind shears between the doors; the reward below the right shelf.

MR05_C02.note: Root Loom: a four-anchor swing over thorns to the heart seed and back.

MR05_C03.note: Moss Well: a non-cling rock wall splits the well; climb the moss walls up and over to the reward.

MR05_C04.note: Seed Choir: three pods over thorns, struck one after another, to the reward.

MR05_C05.note: Stone Drum: a non-cling wall too high for the double jump; bounce off the drum pod to clear it.

MR05_C06.note: Canopy Pocket: up the left wall, glide over the thorns to the reward; swing back along the canopy.

MR06_C01.note: Sheltered Nest: three timed gust lanes along the floor; dash through each calm to the heart seed.

MR06_C02.note: Clasp Hollow: swing over thorns to the reward; a ledge on the right for the swing back.

MR06_C03.note: Wind Window: two full-height gust walls; dash through in their calm.

MR06_C04.note: Echo Steps: crumbling steps over thorns to the reward.

MR06_C05.note: High Drift: up the left wall and glide down to the reward; climb the right wall and swing back.

MR07_C01.note: Reed Shelter: crumbling reeds over thorns to the lore stone.

MR07_C02.note: Falls Pocket: swing over the pool through two falling sheets to the heart seed.

MR07_C03.note: Pale Archive: ride the shelf across the thorns to the reward.

MR07_C04.note: Quiet Terrace: glide over thorns to the reward; up the right wall and swing back.

MR07_C06.note: Upper Cleft (entered on the right): up the moss wall and over a non-cling rock to the amber; a ladder back.

PC01.note: Firefly Nook: a rock rise too high for one jump; the first place to use the Leapseed.

PC08.note: Millstone Pocket: climb the moss wall to a perch and drop over the millstone to the heart seed.

PC10.note: Rootlight Niche: bounce off the pod to clear the root wall.

PC12.note: Last Cairn: a gust over thorns guards the lore stone; dash through the calm.

HEART.note: Great Heart Hall: four sealed sector balconies around the heart; none reaches it (user, 31 Oct).

PC03.note: Fern Pocket: a rock rise too high for one jump.

PC04.note: Mason's Recess: a find on the floor (this pocket has no way in yet).

PC05.note: Dripstone Hollow: up the right wall to the shelf.

PC06.note: Forgotten Satchel: a crumbling step over thorns.

PC07.note: Seed Shelf: swing over the thorns to the find.

PC09.note: Lantern Rest: through a timed drip.

PC11.note: Quiet Wind Pocket: through a gust in its calm.

MR05_C01.note: Lost Lantern: crumbling stones over thorns to the find.

MR06_C06.note: Weather Cave: crumbling steps through two gust walls over thorns.

MR07_C05.note: Watcher's Hollow: up the left wall, glide over thorns to the find; the right wall and a glide back.
